_comment: AI 插画的画风，按主题匹配。illustrate.mjs 会把这里的描述、主题配色和底色一起拼进提示词。content.json 的 illustration.style 可以覆盖。
editorial: refined editorial illustration for a business magazine, gouache texture, subtle grain, calm and intelligent mood
swiss: minimal Swiss-style geometric illustration, flat primary shapes on a strict grid, bold and simple, lots of white space
midnight: isometric tech illustration on a near-black background, thin glowing neon lines, subtle grid, futuristic but clean
glass: soft 3D glassmorphism illustration, frosted translucent rounded shapes, pastel glow, clean studio render
bento: clean 3D icon-style illustration, rounded friendly objects, soft shadows, product-render feel
cloud: airy minimalist line-and-wash illustration, soft muted morandi colors, gentle and calm, lots of empty space
earth: warm earthy illustration with a risograph paper-grain feel, terracotta, caramel and olive tones, organic shapes
notebook: hand-drawn doodle illustration in a notebook sketch style, black ink lines with highlighter-marker accents
memo: simple friendly flat icon illustration in an iOS style, clean rounded shapes, a touch of warm yellow
brutal: neo-brutalist flat illustration, thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, saturated flat color blocks
pop: pop-art comic illustration, halftone dots, bold black outlines, red yellow and blue
dopamine: playful flat vector illustration, candy colors, soft rounded shapes, cheerful and bouncy, small gradient blobs
y2k: Y2K / Y3K illustration with liquid chrome shapes, holographic iridescent gradients and four-point sparkles
prosperity: maximalist vintage decorative illustration, burgundy and joyful pink, scalloped edges, gold details, festive
riso: risograph print illustration, two-color fluorescent pink and blue overprint, visible grain, slight misregistration
pixel: pixel art illustration in a 32-bit retro game style, crisp pixels, limited palette
film: cinematic film-still illustration, moody warm lighting, film grain, wide composition
guochao: modern Chinese guochao illustration, vermilion red and gold, auspicious cloud motifs, bold flat shapes
shanshui: Chinese ink-wash shanshui illustration, mineral blue-green hills, rice-paper texture, elegant restraint
collage: paper collage illustration, torn and cut-out paper shapes, washi tape, kraft paper texture, scrapbook feel
quiet: contemporary minimalist editorial monoline illustration on a warm off-white paper ground; one stable person or object performing one clear action; sparse slightly uneven black contour lines, restrained expression, mildly naive proportions; dominant clean negative space; one tiny muted-vermilion accent on the load-bearing turn; line weight strong enough to stay legible in a reduced thumbnail; no shading, no hatching, no dense texture
